definitions.gloss: Fukuzawa Yukichi, Meiji-era educator and reformer
definitions.explanation: A scholar who introduced Western ideas to Japan and founded {慶応義塾大学|けいおうぎじゅくだいがく} (Keio University). Author of {学問|がくもん}のすすめ (An Encouragement of Learning), he was long the face of the 10,000-yen note, so his name became a slang word for a 10,000-yen bill.

examples.japanese: {福沢諭吉|ふくざわゆきち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{慶応|けいおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{創立|そうりつ}→創立：15353_souritsu⟧した。
{諭吉|ゆきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧3⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。

{福沢諭吉|ふくざわゆきち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{造|つく}らず」という⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}でも→今でも：20772_imademo⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Fukuzawa Yukichi's saying "Heaven does not create one person above or below another" is still well known today.

notes:
His given name {諭吉|ゆきち} became casual slang for a ¥10,000 note, since his portrait appeared on it from 1984 to 2024.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {諭吉|ゆきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to spend a 10,000-yen bill (slang)
- ⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧のすすめ: An Encouragement of Learning, his best-known book

CULTURAL NOTE:
He founded {慶応義塾大学|けいおうぎじゅくだいがく}, championed Western learning and individual independence during the Meiji era, and was the face of the ¥10,000 note for four decades before being replaced by {渋沢栄一|しぶさわえいいち} in the 2024 redesign.
